scientific.integrity: The primary open preprint was inspected at its model, assumptions, conservation law, equilibrium definitions, global-dynamics results, and explicit open question on infected total lockdown. Closely relevant open primary studies on single-strain degenerate reaction-diffusion and positive-dispersal patch dynamics were materially compared. All general conclusions are supported by exact dissipation and finite-dimensional spectral arguments; bundled exact-rational checks are corroborative. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The exact boundary d1=d2=0 is studied on a finite symmetric connected patch graph, not by taking an interchange of time and small-positive-dispersal limits. The global theorem ensures convergence to a risk-tied equilibrium face; individual composition limits under tied seeded risks are not asserted. It does not apply to standard incidence, asymmetric migration, or demographic turnover.

title: Risk-ranked equilibrium simplices and seeded selection under total infected lockdown
